dshell.description: Login shell for new users. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: /bin/bash).

skel.description: Directory containing skeleton files for new home directories. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: /etc/skel).

first_system_uid.description: First UID reserved for system users. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 100).

last_system_uid.description: Last UID reserved for system users. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 999).

first_system_gid.description: First GID reserved for system groups. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 100).

last_system_gid.description: Last GID reserved for system groups. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 999).

first_uid.description: First UID for regular (non-system) users. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 1000).

last_uid.description: Last UID for regular (non-system) users. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 59999).

first_gid.description: First GID for regular (non-system) groups. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 1000).

last_gid.description: Last GID for regular (non-system) groups. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 59999).

usergroups.description: Whether each non-system user gets their own group. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: yes).

dir_mode.description: Permission mode for regular user home directories. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 0700).

sys_dir_mode.description: Permission mode for system user home directories. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 0755).

name_regex.description: Regex for validating regular username. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\$?$).

sys_name_regex.description: Regex for validating system username. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\$?$).

skel_ignore_regex.description: Regex for files in SKEL to exclude from copying. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: \\\.(dpkg\\|ucf\\)-(old\\|new\\|dist\\|save)\$).

extra_groups.description: Additional groups to add new non-system users to. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: users).
